ownerFactRefs.scope: E2 Proposal internal version design: supersede the 140/141 Proposal generation version-family architecture while preserving the approved 136 Explore feasibility facts and E2 required outcomes.
requiredOutcomes: Do not establish independent long-lived version lifecycles for Context, ActionPackage, verification selection/evidence schema, renderer, or Verification Catalog.

E2 itself continues on the pre-E2/current runner and may implement generic Verification; post-E2 prospective three-file writer activates only after the E2 checkpoint, with F1 as first formal dogfood consumer.
Flowkit product version remains the product-level version; current Git/source defines current internal implementation.
Historical E1 persisted shapes remain immutable and readable through small bounded legacy compatibility; do not migrate historical E1 Runs or build a generic migration/version framework.

Historical verification publication should validate persisted bytes/fingerprint/binding rather than require renderer-version replay; keep only the minimum bounded compatibility mechanism actually required.

Preserve generic Change Verification, current-Change decoupling, prospective three-file Run, historical E1 readability, crash/recovery correctness, next-consumer regressions, and E1→E2→F1→G1 dependency boundary without expanding into F1/G1/03 scope.
Use a minimal formatVersion only when a persisted breaking format cannot be reliably discriminated structurally by the latest reader; formatVersion is only a serialization discriminator.
Verification Catalog has no generation lifecycle; current source is authority and point-in-time identity uses content fingerprint when needed.

findings.title: post-E2 three-file writer activation incorrectly expires at the next Delivery Start
findings.problem: The prospective writer gate checks only snapshot.gitBoundaries for the current Delivery. readGitBoundarySummaries(repoRoot, deliveryId) intentionally projects boundaries owned by that Delivery, so after 02 completes and a new Delivery starts, the E2 checkpoint is no longer present in the new Delivery snapshot. The same latest code therefore falls back to the pre-E2 full-entry/sidecar writer in 03 and later Deliveries.
findings.contractRef: specs/flowkit-formal-fact-reader-and-persistence/spec.md Requirement current structural ContextFile; specs/flowkit-lean-run-and-action-package/spec.md post-E2 prospective Apply; design.md Decision E2 checkpoint is sole writer transition boundary
findings.invariant: Once the recognized E2 Change Checkpoint has occurred, the prospective three-file writer is the current product writer for F1 and all later Changes/Deliveries; a later Delivery Start must not erase or reverse that product transition.
findings.requiredOutcome: Make post-E2 writer activation a repository-global monotonic fact derived from the recognized E2 checkpoint (or an equivalent already-authorized durable Git fact), not from the current Delivery-only boundary projection. Preserve the rule that production code presence alone cannot self-activate before the E2 checkpoint.
acceptance: Before the E2 checkpoint, E2 Apply/revise-apply still uses the pre-E2 sidecar protocol.
After the E2 checkpoint, F1/G1 use the three-file writer.
After a later Delivery Start, a new Apply/revise-apply still uses compact context identity and creates only action.md/context.json/result.json.
Add a regression spanning two Delivery Start boundaries so the writer cannot revert in 03 or later Deliveries.

findings.title: formal Change Verification does not execute a changed affected regression in the selected execution scope
findings.problem: 149 actualChangeSet includes tests/unit/services/a1-write-service.test.ts and Catalog maps tests/unit/services to the execution module, selecting tests-execution. However the physical resolver for tests-execution only runs two facts tests plus b1-run-execution-service.test.ts; it does not run a1-write-service.test.ts. Thus the formal verification can report tests-execution passed even when the changed regression itself fails.
findings.contractRef: specs/flowkit-change-verification-selection/spec.md generic deterministic selection and compatible affected test aggregation; tasks.md 5.1 and 7.1; design.md Decision affected execution aggregates compatible test files
findings.invariant: A formal affected verification check selected because of an actual changed path must execute a test set that covers that affected path/consumer relation; union/dedupe may reduce process count but must not drop required affected tests.
findings.requiredOutcome: Make logical affected-test resolution preserve the complete required affected test union for selected modules/paths while still deduplicating compatible Node execution. The concrete implementation may reuse the existing affected-scope resolver or another deterministic mapping, but must not omit changed/required affected regressions.
acceptance: For an actualChangeSet containing tests/unit/services/a1-write-service.test.ts, formal Change Verification executes that test (or a formally equivalent complete affected test set that contains it).
A failing sentinel in that changed regression makes the selected tests-execution evidence fail rather than pass.
The compatible Node union remains deduplicated and does not regress to one process per logical module.
Re-run E2 Change Verification and bind the corrected passed evidence before re-review.
